name: story-search-results
title: Search results story
description: Dot animation of a typed query, three ranked results and their highlighted passages.
usage: The hero of a search product page (the Search page shows it in the hero demo). Draw it in a white card on the ring pattern. Plays only on screen; shows its resting picture with reduced motion.
avoid: Stories as the main content of a page
notes: A query is typed into the field at the top, three results sweep in under it with their source, title and relevance (a filled chip for high, an outline for medium), then each passage highlights the span that answers the query.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
